tools.name: list_perpetuals
tools.title: List USDT-M perpetuals
tools.description: List every USDT-M perpetual futures contract currently trading on Binance, including altcoins, memecoins, and new listings. Optionally filter by a substring and sort newest-listed first.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the symbol, e.g. 'DOGE'.

newestFirst.description: Sort by listing date, newest contracts first. Defaults to alphabetical.

limit.description: Maximum number of symbols to return. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: market_movers
tools.title: Market movers
tools.description: Rank Binance USDT-M perpetuals by 24h price change or traded volume to see what is running right now. Returns last price, 24h change %, high/low, and quote volume for each contract.

minQuoteVolume.description: Ignore contracts below this 24h quote volume in USDT, to filter out illiquid noise. Defaults to 1,000,000.

limit.description: Number of contracts to return. Defaults to 15.

tools.name: analyze_symbol
tools.title: Run the swarm on a symbol
tools.description: Run Alpha Swarm's four trading agents (Trend, MeanRev, Breakout, Meme) over recent Binance candles for one USDT-M perpetual and return each agent's vote plus the weighted consensus BUY/SELL/NEUTRAL signal and confidence. Analysis only — this places no orders.

interval.description: Candle interval to analyze. Defaults to '1m'.

threshold.description: Weighted net score needed to emit a directional signal. Lower is more sensitive. Defaults to 0.6.
